set.subtitle: Smoke Set

materials.title: 听力题目说明
materials.content:
W: Are you going to the museum on Friday?
M: I planned to, but the train strike may change my plan.
W: Then let's meet on Saturday instead.

materials.title: PASSAGE ONE — Learning by Teaching
materials.content:
(1) Students who explain a concept to others tend to remember it longer.
(2) The act of explaining forces them to reorganize what they know and to notice gaps in their understanding.

questions.stem: Why may the man change his plan?

options.text: He has to work on Friday.
The train strike may affect his trip.
The museum is closed on Friday.

questions.explanation: 答案 B。男士说 the train strike may change my plan。

questions.stem: The two speakers will meet on ______.

questions.label: 写作
questions.stem: Write a short passage of about 120 words explaining one benefit of teaching others.

answer.reference: Teaching others helps learners reorganize knowledge and notice gaps.
